verdict.rationale: The docs name a first-party Batch Processing API for high-volume processing and asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios. Bulk data extraction is also documented through date-ranged exports across customers, cases and transactions. However, the batch API appears only in a single sentence, and the monitoring configuration endpoints are explicitly single-customer. Missing for 10: documented details of the Batch Processing API (supported operations, payload limits), bulk case/alert decisioning or bulk monitor/unmonitor actions, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk operations.
